Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: Infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt()
Vulnerabilities.Description: An issue was discovered in OpenSSL before 1.1.1n where custom curves could trigger an infinite loop during validation.

Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: execution of arbitrary command via c_rehash script
Vulnerabilities.Description: In OpenSSL a vulnerability was discovered where c_rehash script does not properly sanitize inputs, allowing commands execution.

Vulnerabilities.Title: nettle: RSA decryption crash
Vulnerabilities.Description: A flaw was found in nettle where RSA decryption crashes when processing specific crafted ciphertext.

Vulnerabilities.Title: libssh2: Out-of-bounds read in SSH protocol handler
Vulnerabilities.Description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in libssh2 when handling SSH handshakes.
